title: [Performance] First contentful paint delayed by 1–2 seconds in beta.27 after parallel module imports

milestone.title: Future
milestone.description: Unscheduled feature work beyond GA. Placement here is not a commitment to a specific release. Goose should move items to a numbered milestone only when that release scope is justified.

body:
### Wails version family v3 ### Exact Wails version v3.0.0-beta.27 ### Operating System Windows ### Description After upgrading a Windows application from Wails v3.0.0-alpha2.117 to v3.0.0-beta.27, the native window appears promptly but its content stays blank noticeably longer. The example imports 24 tiny local ES modules in parallel, then inserts a heading and two paragraphs into the DOM. Each module handler immediately returns a single export statement. On my machine, production builds gave the following FCP timings. Each version has 8 measured launches after one warm-up; execution order alternates between versions. | Version | Median | Range | Launches above 1 second | | --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | | alpha2.117 | 602.9 ms | 582.8–674.0 ms | 0/8 | | beta.27 | 2102.1 ms | 592.6–2676.3 ms | 7/8 | In all 8 beta samples, the DOM insertion finished 96.3–108.6 ms after navigation began. In the slow samples, FCP followed about 1–2 seconds later. No JavaScript long tasks (>50 ms), error events, or unhandled rejections were captured. The two binaries run from the same executable path, use the same WebView2 user-data directory and have the same window size. ### To Reproduce [Wails-Startup-Repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33025737/Wails-Startup-Repro.zip) 1. Extract the archive on Windows with Go 1.25+, PowerShell 7 and WebView2 installed. 2. Open PowerShell in the extracted Wails-Startup-Repro directory and run: ```powershell ./build.ps1 ./profile.ps1 -Runs 8 -Warmups 1 -Modules 24 ``` 3. Compare results/\/summary.json and samples.json. Individual \-\.json files contain the browser paint entries, navigation/resource timing, DOM insertion time, visibility changes, long tasks and errors. environment.json records the environment, build information and hashes. The key frontend sequence is simply: ```js await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: moduleCount }, (_, index) => import(`/modules/${index}.js`))) document.querySelector('#app').innerHTML = '

First content is visible

...' ``` ### Expected behaviour Once the imports have completed and content has been inserted into a visible window, the first contentful paint should follow promptly, without an additional intermittent 1–2 second blank interval. Under the same workload and environment, beta.27 should have startup latency comparable to alpha2.117. ### Screenshots _No response_ ### Attempted Fixes - Downgrading to v3.0.0-alpha2.117 restored its fast startup. - Tested smaller module counts. A single-module control did not reproduce the delay; 8 modules reproduced it intermittently, and 24 modules reproduced it in 7/8 measured beta launches. Search references: - https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/issues?q=is%3Aissue+startup - https://github.com/wailsapp/wails/discussions?discussions_q=startup - https://www.google.com/search?q=site%3Agithub.com%2Fwailsapp%2Fwails+%22startup%22+%22paint%22 ### System Details ```shell Command: go run github.com/wailsapp/wails/v3/cmd/wails3@v3.0.0-beta.27 doctor (Terminal progress animation and styling omitted.) Wails v3.0.0-beta.27 › Wails Doctor # System Name | Windows 10 Pro Version | 2009 (Build: 22621) ID | 22H2 Branding | Windows 11 Pro Platform | windows Architecture | amd64 Go WebView2Loader | true WebView2 Version | 154.0.4258.53 CPU | 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11800H @ 2.30GHz GPU | NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA) Memory | 64GB # Build Environment Wails CLI | v3.0.0-beta.27 Go Version | go1.25.0 -buildmode | exe -compiler | gc CGO_ENABLED | 0 GOAMD64 | v1 GOARCH | amd64 GOOS | windows # Dependencies *Android SDK | Not found. Set ANDROID_HOME (install via Android Studio or the command-line tools). MSIX Packaging Tool | Not Installed MakeAppx.exe (Windows SDK) | Not Installed NSIS | Not Installed SignTool.exe (Windows SDK) | Not Installed npm | 11.19.0 docker | *Docker version 27.5.1, build 9f9e405 (daemon not running) * - Optional Dependency # Signing macOS Signing | Not configured Windows Signing | Not configured Linux Signing | Not configured (GPG) # Checking for issues SUCCESS No issues found # Diagnosis SUCCESS Your system is ready for Wails development! Additional environment details: Windows 11 Pro 22H2, OS build 22621.1848. NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU driver: 32.0.15.5599. Intel UHD Graphics driver: 31.0.101.5330. WebView2: 154.0.4258.53; devicePixelRatio: 2.5. Window options: 1280 x 800; measured content viewport: 1268 x 765 CSS pixels. No WEBVIEW2* environment variables were set during profiling. Exact version command: go run github.com/wailsapp/wails/v3/cmd/wails3@v3.0.0-beta.27 version Output: v3.0.0-beta.27 ``` ### Additional context For my real project reproduction, check out [Touhou-Tagger](https://github.com/the1812/Touhou-Tagger). - Slow Startup: [a8924ac](https://github.com/the1812/Touhou-Tagger/commit/a8924ac50b3904992009ce9bf38d289380047bae). Uses Go Wails `v3.0.0-beta.27` and `@wailsio/runtime` `3.0.0-beta.27`. - Fast Startup: [a137b40](https://github.com/the1812/Touhou-Tagger/commit/a137b40cac8c1bc21b085cecfd83eae84a23fdbe). Uses Go Wails `v3.0.0-alpha2.117` and `@wailsio/runtime` `3.0.0-alpha.97`.
